body.text: Ruhullah Mehdi opens up on his rift with the Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC), accusing the party of abandoning the fight for Article 370, and confirms he will resign on November 3, 2026.

In this episode of Frontline Conversations, Aga Syed Ruhullah Mehdi, Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC) MP from Srinagar, confirms that he will resign from the party on November 3, 2026, saying Farooq Abdullah’s recent statement on Article 370 left him with no reason to reconsider.

Mehdi speaks about his growing differences with JKNC over Article 370, 35A and the demand for restoration of constitutional protections for Jammu and Kashmir. He accuses the party leadership of abandoning the political agenda on which it sought the people’s mandate.

The conversation also looks at Mehdi’s criticism of Chief Minister Omar Abdullah’s political positions, the contrast between the National Conference and Congress on constitutional protections, minorities and Kashmir, and his possible political path after leaving the party, including continued engagement with the Congress.
